notes.proposed: TFV-first sparse-state + differentiable continuous MPC. Runs on the controls-disabled physical base; priority PFV is soft/diagnostic, never a hard admission gate.
notes.no_control: No-supervisory-RTC. Remove executable [CONTROLS] and make no Python writes, while preserving physical forcing, pump curves/initial status and intrinsic [PUMPS] Startup/Shutoff level logic. This is neither All-open nor All-closed.
notes.internal_rtc: Original frozen event INP with native [CONTROLS] enabled and no Python setting writes.
notes.all_open: Extreme diagnostic comparator on the controls-disabled base; from the first common control decision command every eligible continuous setting to 1.0 and hold it there.
notes.all_closed: Extreme diagnostic comparator on the controls-disabled base; from the first common control decision command every eligible continuous setting to 0.0 and hold it there.

excluded_formal_strategies.hold: Available only for runtime debugging. On a controls-disabled base its frozen first-decision readback can collapse to the same effective policy as No-control, so it is excluded to avoid a duplicate comparator.

policy_isolation.common_precontrol_prefix: Proposed, All-open and All-closed share the same controls-disabled prefix until the frozen control_start_minutes epoch. No-control stays on that no-supervisory-RTC base for the entire event.
